name: Sales overview
description: Revenue, orders and customers at a glance.

widgets.title: Revenue
widgets.summary: Total value of completed orders, in rupees.
widgets.sql: SELECT SUM(o.amt) / 100.0 AS revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.sts = 1

widgets.title: Completed orders
widgets.summary: Number of orders that were completed (not cancelled or refunded).
widgets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.sts = 1

widgets.title: Average order value
widgets.summary: Revenue divided by the number of completed orders.
widgets.sql: SELECT SUM(o.amt) / 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS aov FROM orders o WHERE o.sts = 1

widgets.title: Refund rate
widgets.summary: Share of all orders that were refunded.
widgets.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.sts = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS refund_rate FROM orders o

widgets.title: Revenue by month
widgets.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(o.amt) / 100.0 AS revenue
FROM orders o WHERE o.sts = 1
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

widgets.title: Revenue by customer segment
widgets.summary: How revenue splits across Retail, Wholesale and Corporate customers.
widgets.sql:
SELECT CASE c.sgmt WHEN 1 THEN 'Retail' WHEN 2 THEN 'Wholesale' WHEN 3 THEN 'Corporate' END AS segment, SUM(o.amt) / 100.0 AS revenue
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.sts = 1
GROUP BY c.sgmt ORDER BY revenue DESC

widgets.title: Revenue by product category
widgets.summary: Revenue from completed orders, split by product category.
widgets.sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.sts = 1
GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

widgets.title: Revenue by city
widgets.summary: Which cities bring in the most revenue.
widgets.sql:
SELECT c.city, SUM(o.amt) / 100.0 AS revenue
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.sts = 1
GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY revenue DESC

widgets.title: Top 10 products
widgets.summary: Best-selling products from completed orders, ranked by revenue.
widgets.sql:
SELECT p.name AS product, p.category, SUM(oi.qty) AS units,
       SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.sts = 1
GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
